name: Knockback
storyline: A city has fallen to the infected. Fight through the street, the sewer, the mall and the rooftops to reach the lab and the one who started it all: The Big One, the Brood Mother, the Riot Brute, the Spitter King and finally Patient Zero stand in the way.
summary: Knockback is a free browser game with three modes that share one set of characters and controls. Horde is co-operative survival for one to five players: numbered waves of zombies attack on an arena whose floor wraps around, a knockout puts a player down until a teammate stands them up, and the wave reached is the score. Streets is a side-scrolling beat-'em-up for up to five players across five stages (a street, a sewer, a mall, rooftops and a lab), each ending in a boss, with punches, a launcher, a jump kick, a dash attack and weapon pickups. Brawl is a five-player platform fighter where hits push opponents rather than killing them; health decides how far a hit throws you, and falling off the stage costs a life, with server-side bots filling empty seats. Matches run on an authoritative server with client prediction, support public and private rooms, and work on phones in portrait as well as on desktop. No download or account is required, and every mode can be played alone.
